test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Adi had __not only assisted her by__ giving evidence in the case but also provided many examples to prove her point in the court.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. assisted her not only by .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses a **correlative conjunction** "not only...but also" to emphasize two related actions performed by Adi.
 
• The placement of "not only" is crucial to ensure proper sentence structure and meaning.
 
• In option 2, "assisted her not only by" correctly aligns with the grammatical structure of correlative conjunctions.
 
• The other options disrupt the logical flow or grammatical correctness of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Adi had assisted her not only by giving evidence in the case but also provided many examples to prove her point in the court.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Correlative Conjunctions:**

 
 
• **Examples:** not only...but also, either...or, neither...nor.
 
• **Usage:** These conjunctions connect two related ideas or emphasize two actions.
 
• **Example:** She is not only intelligent but also hardworking.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Misplacement of "not only" and "but also" can confuse the meaning or disrupt sentence structure.
 
• Ensure parallelism when using correlative conjunctions (e.g., both phrases should have a similar grammatical form).
